identity.principle: zuizuiの強みは、抽象理論を現実の生物・データ・観測系へ降ろせる接点と、現実側の失敗・残差・観測不能性を再び理論へ戻せる接点を見つけること。
identity.rule: developmental ancestry is not conceptual hierarchy; theory-real contact is typed and never transfers claim ownership

observation_architecture.statement: Unobservability is relative to a scientific target and an observation map. The important object is which distinctions in Omega survive record entry, refinement and semantic representation.

operators.rec: missing support: exposures/world states that fail to become usable rows; external exposure/reference is required to speak empirically about the non-entered world
operators.v3: retained refinement: already-available side/reference information may contract compatible world sets without destructive subtraction
operators.tnoa: semantic preservation: on retained support, target/nuisance/observability/attribution/unresolved distinctions are preserved instead of prematurely collapsed
operators.boundary: identification boundary: the current observation map induces observational equivalence and determines which scientific distinctions are identifiable in principle
operators.mrod: active refinement: choose a future observation that most usefully splits the remaining compatible mechanism/world set

observation_architecture.topology: REC, V3 and TNOA are sibling information operations, not a mandatory linear pipeline. They constrain or refine the observation map that Boundary audits; MROD acts after the surviving unresolved set is explicit.

application.pollipi: flower-visitation physical implementation focused on retaining a comparable primary record and target-facing candidate evidence
application.insepi: physical observation-system intervention testbed focused on nuisance/observability/shared-optical failure diagnosis
application.rule: PolliPi/InsePi are applications/testbeds of the observation problem, not the conceptual parents of REC/V3/TNOA/Boundary/MROD even though they were historically important in discovering those questions

contact_edges.object: non-entered support creates distinctions the final record cannot identify
retained side information contracts compatible worlds before identification is judged
preserved observation states determine which distinctions remain available to identify
surviving equivalence/identified set -> next observation choice
target-facing process-preserving observation semantics -> flower-visitor recording design
prospective same-system exposure/entry audit for REC H6
specific mechanism-allocation ambiguity -> general identification boundary
WHAT to measure <-> WHERE to look
biological sampling need -> bounded search geography
candidate patch -> field verification and primary-data intake
future-relevant-state idea -> independent natural-data adequacy gates; not external validation of the finite model
Honshu-Izu functional interaction data under different questions
empirical measurement/representation adequacy before reportability licensing

development_history_not_current_hierarch: PolliPi/InsePi historically motivated parts of TNOA/V3, but current conceptual direction is theory -> application as well as application failure -> theory revision.
TNOA historically preceded REC, but REC is conceptually upstream with respect to record entry.
V3 is not fixed between REC and TNOA; it is a refinement operator that can act wherever retained side information exists before irreversible loss/coarsening.
portfolio_cycle: derive a boundary, theorem, or design rule
project it back into a measurable natural or physical system
treat failure, non-identifiability and residual structure as new scientific information
revise the theoretical representation without erasing provenance
